description: WEEKNUM stale return_type: does a state change made before an abandoned read stay? A3 sets Monday and then reads A1 (not yet calculated), so it is abandoned; A2, a plain reader, runs next and shows Monday if the change stayed, - if it was rolled back. Readers decode the reused start weekday: WEEKNUM(2..7,99) joined gives 111111 Sun, 222222 Mon, 122222 Tue, 112222 Wed, 111222 Thu, 111122 Fri, 111112 Sat; markers WEEKNUM(100,t) with t 1 Sun, 2 Mon, 12 Tue, 13 Wed, 14 Thu (T-1484)
